title: Cairo Scene export
scenario: Compare canonical scenes, inspect a vector PDF and replay a missing image resource.
fixture: Four canonical scenes and five feature checks

slides.caption: Canonical primitive scene
slides.action: Replay the portable primitive fixture on Cairo.
slides.expected: Across the four canonical fixtures the original Canvas and software checksums match their pins.

slides.caption: Plot scene through the same adapter
slides.action: Switch to the plot gallery fixture and replay its 67 commands.
slides.expected: Mean RGB difference from the software rendering is 3.30 on the 0–255 channel scale.

slides.caption: Vector PDF at four pixels per point
slides.action: Export the feature cells to PDF, extract the path, text and image, then rasterize.
slides.expected: The PDF contains the three edges of the black triangle. All five feature checks pass.

slides.caption: Missing resource and renderer differences
slides.action: Replay the unresolved image handle alongside the owned two-color bitmap. Compare the rendered rows.
slides.expected: Cairo reports handle 17 and leaves the rightmost cell blank. The adjacent owned bitmap is visible in Cairo and PDF.
